credit: Free workshops hosted by KCL Inclusive Careers Education Ambassadors.
intro_title: Never written a line of code? Start here.
intro_text: CodeCamp teaches Python from absolute zero, in small friendly sessions, to students on any course.
week_1_text: Core programming concepts, functions, data structures, debugging and good coding habits.
week_2_text: Use Python on real STEM data: clean it, analyse it and turn it into charts worth showing.
week_3_text: Use GitHub and simple deployment tools to publish a working project you can put on your CV.
welcome_text: You don't need a computing background, a fancy laptop or the "right" kind of brain. Everyone starts at the same line, questions are the point and you'll always have someone sitting with you while you work it out.
